notes.title: v3.9 Released! (Almost version 4! 😄)
notes.notes:
[h3][b]• Runs 5.8x faster.[/b][/h3]

• Windows can now be assigned to profiles (for automatic switching based on the window).

• Missing features are now complete.

• Chain feature has been improved.

As many new additions and changes as I'm too lazy to count...
...
(Note: Major changes to the menus and icons haven't been made yet, but they haven't been forgotten.)

notes.title: MouseMob v3.6 (Pre-Release for v4)
notes.notes:
• You can now change the "F1" key, which is used to add new mouse area.

• You can also assign your own key to run not just the mouse area adding feature, but many other functions.

• We made several important changes for more stable performance.

notes.title: MouseMob v3.5 (Pre-Release for v4)
notes.notes:
[u][b]MouseMob v3.5 ( Pre-Release for v4 )[/b][/u]

[u][b]INFO:[/b][/u]
Preparations for the transition from v3 to v4 are underway.
However, since it is a quite large update, the process is taking longer than expected.
Therefore, I wanted to release an intermediate version, v3.5, until v4 is completed.

[u][b]NOTE:[/b][/u]
This version has the advanced interface of v4, but new features are missing and under development.
Your advice based on your experiences is important. Please do not hesitate to comment.

[u][b]NEW FEATURES:[/b][/u]
• CHAIN FEATURE (new)
This is for triggering multiple mobs with a single click. (Currently, only mouse, key, and text events can be added to chains. Work is underway for more...)
• PORTAL FEATURE (new)
Add pairs of Portals to the screen and teleport your cursor between them.
• AUTOMATIC SAVE (new)
Everything is saved automatically when you exit the software. When you open the software again, you will continue from where you left off.
• PROFILE LIST (new)
Easily save your profiles and switch between them at any time.
• RESIZE (new)
Now Mobs can be very small or gigantic.
• Text Event (new)
Mobs can now send long texts.

notes.title: v3.1 Released!
notes.notes:
v3.1 Release Notes

• Fixed Crash Issues: Resolved various problems causing the application to crash unexpectedly.

• Resolved Double-Click Bug: Corrected an issue where a single click was sometimes registered as two clicks.

• Addressed Unintended Key Bindings: Fixed the problem of the application sending unintended key presses after assigning a new key.

• Improved Modifier Key Reliability: Enhanced the stability and accuracy of modifier key (e.g., Shift, Ctrl, Alt) transmissions.

notes.title: 🚀 MOUSEMOB v3 RELEASED! A HUGE UPDATE FOR A WHOLE NEW EXPERIENCE! 🚀
notes.notes:
[p]🚀 MOUSEMOB v3 RELEASED! A HUGE UPDATE FOR A WHOLE NEW EXPERIENCE! 🚀[/p][p]Hello MouseMob Community! [/p][p]The moment you've been eagerly awaiting is finally here! We're thrilled to announce that [b]MouseMob v3[/b] has been released! With this update, we've made MouseMob much more powerful, convenient, and secure. We've introduced brand new features, especially [b]3 key new additions[/b] that will completely transform your workflow! Get ready, details below! 👇[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]✨ DISCOVER THE NEW FEATURES![/p][p]• [b]BIDIRECTIONAL OPERATION (BRAND NEW FEATURE!) [/b]🔁[/p][p]MouseMob can now work bidirectionally! What does this mean? You can now send [b]keyboard actions with your mouse[/b] and [b]mouse actions with your keyboard[/b]![/p][p]• If you press the assigned key on your keyboard, a click is sent to the Mob's location (Existing feature).[/p][p]• If you hover your mouse over the Mob's location or click the Mob (selectable from Key Event), the assigned key is sent.[/p][p]Simply right-click on the Mob(s) you've added to your screen and choose a "Mouse Event" or "Key Event." Whether you left-click on Mobs to send a keyboard key or hover your mouse over them for a duration, the choice is yours![/p][p][/p][p]• [b]ADD NEW MOB WITH A SINGLE KEY (BRAND NEW FEATURE!) [/b]🖱️[/p][p]You can now add a new Mob at your mouse's current location by simply pressing the "F1" key! Adding Mobs has never been this easy! 🖱️[/p][p][/p][p]• [b]CLICK COUNTER (BRAND NEW FEATURE!) [/b]🔢[/p][p]When you trigger a Mob by holding down a key, a counter will now appear, showing the number of clicks in real-time! Instantly track your clicks![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ IMPROVED INFRASTRUCTURE & OPTIMIZATIONS\[/p>
[/p][p]• [b]SPECIAL KEY SUPPORT (IMPROVED INFRASTRUCTURE!) [/b]⌨️[/p][p]Keys that were not allowed to be assigned to your mouse in the previous version, such as "Capslock, Alt+Tab, Ctrl+F1, and other special keys..." are [b]all assignable in v3![/b] Restrictions are gone![/p][p][/p][p]• [b]MORE SECURE [/b]🔒[/p][p]• When triggering Mobs with multiple keys, MouseMob could sometimes send keys intermittently when it should have only sent clicks. This issue has been [b]completely resolved in v3![/b] Your clicks are now much more reliable.[/p][p]• To ensure clicks land precisely on Mobs, MouseMob restricts your mouse movement. However, if a click changed the active window, this restriction could break. In [b]v3, we've strengthened our background feature, Mouse Trap![/b] It's now more robust.[/p][p][/p][p]• [b]MORE EFFICIENT [/b]🚀[/p][p]In older versions, when you triggered Mobs by holding down a key, your mouse would change position for each click. In [b]v3, a smarter structure has been implemented; it only changes position when necessary![/b] This has increased efficiency and stability![/p][p][/p][p]• [b]MORE CONSISTENT [/b]✅[/p][p]When holding down a key to continuously trigger Mobs and then releasing it to stop, the mouse could sometimes continue clicking for a short period. In [b]v3, this issue has been eliminated![/b] The clicking action stops immediately when you release the key.[/p][p][/p][p]• [b]MORE USER-FRIENDLY (ACTIVE WINDOW FOCUS IS NOT LOST!) [/b]🎯[/p][p]• The key change interface that opens to assign new keys to Mobs would cause your active window to lose focus when it closed. In [b]v3, when the key change interface closes, it automatically switches back to your active window![/b][/p][p]• Selecting an option from the Mobs' right-click menu would cause the active window to lose focus. In [b]v3, it automatically switches back to your active window immediately after selection![/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]➕ A FEW MORE THINGS![/p][p]• A bug in the "Lock" feature has been resolved.[/p][p]• Current version information (v3) has been added to the "About" section.[/p][p]• A link to the latest version notes has been added to the "About" section.[/p][p]• "Kivaminda" (brand name) has been removed from the "About" section and replaced with the developer's name. (We are searching for a new brand name...)[/p][p]Please don't hesitate to share your new feature requests or update suggestions with us! Your feedback is invaluable. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]💡 DID YOU KNOW? (NOT V3 SPECIFIC, JUST INFORMATION)[/p][p]Here are some tips to use MouseMob more efficiently:[/p][p]• To add a new Mob to the screen, simply [b]left-click the small icon once.[/b] The newly added Mob will automatically follow your mouse. When you want to place it, you can drop it anywhere on the screen with just [b]one click.[/b][/p][p]• Newly added Mobs are automatically assigned consecutive Numpad keys (Num1, Num2, Num3...) and a Left-click mouse action.[/p][p]• Each Mob has its own unique right-click menu. For example, one Mob can perform a right-click while another performs a left-click.[/p][p]• Mobs can be [b]locked.[/b] This prevents them from being dragged, and your clicks will pass through to objects beneath them, meaning Mobs only appear on the screen. (Single-click to Lock/Unlock)[/p][p]• Mobs can be [b]hidden.[/b] You can hide/show all Mobs with a single click. (Single-click to Hide/Show)[/p][p]• Mobs can perform [b]dragging operations.[/b] (Hold down an object with your mouse, then press your Mob key. It moves to the relevant Mob area.)[/p][p]• When you trigger a Mob with a key, MouseMob prevents potential errors like moving the mouse before clicking, ensuring the click hits the target precisely by:[/p][p]Trapping your mouse cursor in an invisible area. It releases the trap after the click.[/p][p]• MouseMob uses an efficient labeling structure by abbreviating modifier keys you assign to Mobs in the background. CTRL= ^ , ALT= ! , WIN= # , SHIFT= + (e.g., ctrl+shift+e = ^+e)[/p][p]• If you want to assign a new key to a Mob, there's no need to select a key from a list. Just press the keys. Our advanced key detection system automatically recognizes the keys you press and assigns them to the relevant field.[/p][p]• MouseMob automatically localizes the interface and key labels according to your Windows language.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🎯 IN SHORT, MOUSEMOB:[/p][p]• Automatically resolves many things you would otherwise have to set up in the background.[/p][p]• We've worked hard on even the finest details to save you hassle and optimize your experience.[/p][p]• Requires no additional installation or setup.[/p][p]• Can work offline.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for your support! We can't wait to hear about your experiences with MouseMob v3! Don't forget to let us know what you think in the comments![/p]

notes.title: MouseMob v2.0 released
notes.notes:
[p]🖱️ [b]Completely Redesigned Key Assignment System[/b]
The interface and infrastructure for assigning keys to your on-screen mice have been completely redesigned. Just press the key you want to assign to your mice: it is detected automatically and assigned instantly when you release the key.[/p][p]🌍 [b]Consistent Multilingual Button Labels[/b]
Button labels under your mice are now more consistent for multilingual use.[/p][p]🔧 [b]Fixed Mouse Restoration Issue[/b]
A potential issue that could occur when restoring your saved mice has been fixed.[/p][p]Than[/p]
